metadata.title: SolarEdge Appoints Former Enphase Executive Gokul Krishnan to Lead North American Operations

content.text:
SolarEdge Technologies (NASDAQ:SEDG) has appointed Gokul Krishnan as Senior Vice President and General Manager of North America, strengthening its regional leadership as the solar technology company seeks to expand adoption of its next-generation energy solutions.
Krishnan, who is based in California, has already assumed his responsibilities and will oversee SolarEdge's operations across the North American market.
He joins the company following senior leadership positions at Enphase Energy and SunEdison, bringing experience in solar technology, business development and commercial operations.
Krishnan succeeds Amir Cohen, who previously headed SolarEdge's North American organisation. Cohen will assist with the leadership transition while continuing to contribute to other company initiatives.
Krishnan Brings Experience From Enphase Energy and SunEdison
Before joining SolarEdge, Krishnan served as Senior Vice President and General Manager of the consumer business unit at Enphase Energy.
During his time at Enphase, he also led the company's microinverter business unit and global business development activities, gaining experience across product strategy and international commercial operations.
Earlier in his career, Krishnan held several senior positions at SunEdison, including Chief Operating Officer and Vice President of its Residential and Small Commercial business.
He also served as Vice President and General Manager of SunEdison's global module business, overseeing operations within the company's solar equipment activities.
His previous experience includes senior roles at semiconductor companies Cypress Semiconductor and Xilinx.
The appointments throughout his career have provided Krishnan with experience spanning semiconductor technology, solar energy products and commercial management.
SolarEdge's decision to recruit an executive with experience at another major solar technology provider reflects its focus on strengthening leadership in a strategically important market.
SolarEdge Identifies North America as Key Growth Market
SolarEdge Chief Executive Officer Shuki Nir highlighted the importance of the North American business in the company's broader strategy.
"North America is a key market for us. Gokul's background makes him the right leader to accelerate the adoption of our next-generation DC-optimized technologies," Nir said.
The appointment places Krishnan in charge of a region that remains central to SolarEdge's residential and commercial solar technology operations.
